spots.name: Lookout Butte
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,724 m (5,656 ft).

spots.name: Owyhee River Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Three Forks Hot Spring
spots.tip: Steam reads best in cold air at first light. Check access rules; many springs are on private or tribal land.
